Selling automation solutions and services into the manufacturing industry means navigating complex buying cycles and reaching technical decision-makers. MarketJoy has established itself as a leading B2B lead generation company with particular expertise in solving these specific challenges. Through strategic outreach and proven methodologies, MarketJoy gets your solutions in front of the right prospects so your sales engine runs as efficiently as your technology.

Schedule My Free Consultation!

The Challenges of Selling Into Manufacturing

And How Those Challenges Meet Their Match with MarketJoy 

Selling automation into the manufacturing industry can come
with some tough challenges fierce competition, hard-to-reach
decision-makers, and long sales cycles. Add to this,
manufacturing is a huge and hugely diverse “umbrella” industry,
from OEMs to auto manufacturers to CPG goods and more. A
one-size-fits-all B2B marketing strategy simply won’t get the job done for anyone with a clear vision and goals.

One of MarketJoy’s chief specialties is helping companies that
solve manufacturing problems through new automation solutions
and services find their ideal target audience through rigorous
data research and connect with that audience using winning messaging that has been methodically tested for traction.

Success Story

MarketJoy Delivers Consistent Resultsfor  TransAutomation Technologies 

As leaders in robotic palletizer automation solutions, TransAutomation Technologies provides robotic automation in a complete and simple fashion to manufacturing operations across many industry segments.

With a focus on helping American manufacturers gain every useful advantage, they felt an urgency in proactively reaching out but also recognized the complex and time-consuming processes that would be involved in conducting outbound lead generation.

They turned to us, seeking our expertise to navigate this changing
landscape, broaden their brand’s presence, and proactively initiate conversations
with more American manufacturers whom their robotic solutions would give a
strong advantage to.

By the third month of our partnership, after meticulously testing different industry
segments, title-clusters, and messaging, MarketJoy was delivering a consistent stream of new and valuable leads to TransAutomation Technologies, and proudly continues to do so after multiple extensions of our partnership.
